name: MikanEngine Gameplay Script SDK

api.targetRule: Entity arguments default to the script's Self() when omitted or INVALID_ENTITY.

lifecycle.timeStep: The test runner supplies a fixed deltaSeconds; gameplay code should be deterministic for the same input stream.

methods.name: IsAlive
methods.description: Check whether Self or a target still has a live scene identity.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Find the first entity by exact scene name.

methods.name: FindAll
methods.description: Find all entities by exact scene name.

methods.name: Name/Rename
methods.description: Read or change the scene name.

methods.name: Parent/Children/SetParent/RemoveParent
methods.description: Inspect and edit the scene hierarchy with cycle checks.

methods.name: IsVisible/SetVisible
methods.description: Read/write the first supported visibility component.

methods.name: CreateEmpty/CreateCube/CreateSphere
methods.description: Create runtime entities with stable built-in presets.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Queue safe entity destruction; OnDestroy runs before the entity is removed.

methods.name: AttachScript/DetachScript
methods.description: Attach or detach a registered script. Operations during Update are deferred.

methods.name: HasComponent/EnsureComponent/RemoveComponent
methods.description: Use scene serializeKey names to inspect or manage reflected components.

methods.name: SetComponentField
methods.description: Set a reflected field with a JSON scalar/array/string value.

methods.name: GetComponentField
methods.description: Read a reflected field as a JSON value.

methods.name: GetComponentKeys
methods.description: List reflected components attached to an entity in registry order.

methods.name: IsDown/IsPressed/IsReleased/Axis
methods.description: Use semantic actions shared by desktop, touch bindings and CPU synthetic tests.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Write a script-scoped log line with entity and name context.

componentFieldValueFormat.string: JSON quoted string or a simple unquoted value

agentWorkflow: Generate or update a script through create_script
Attach the script through SceneCommand or a scene script component
Run gameplay test with fixed timestep and dump state
Assert state and, when relevant, run render regression
Only deliver after source hash, test result and diagnostics are recorded
